client_brief:
Catalogue-ready component photography, including difficult internal openings

Girdermark sells replacement components. A buyer needs to recognise the finish and the shape, not admire a dramatic studio treatment. Our twelve components were photographed over two bench sessions and need a consistent technical presentation.

The commission

 Industrial SKU plate: 12 named exports. The part geometry agrees with the source component. Source wear, machining marks and identification defects are not retouched away.

 Industrial SKU cutout: 12 named exports. The silhouette preserves all functional holes. The edge has no visible halo.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: The number and the part agree.
brand_identity.sector: Industrial and Manufacturing, wholesale distribution of elevator and electrical replacement parts
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Cleveland, Ohio; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Girdermark Elevator & Electrical Supply is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Cleveland, Ohio, and this commission covers phase 1: components photography and technical sheets.
brand_identity.audience: Working buyers aged 35 to 60 who have specified this class of part for twenty years and judge a supplier by whether the photography and the spec table say the same thing. They order by part number and hold us to the values printed beside it.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Mid to upper industrial. Parts run 400 to 9,000 dollars. The material has to read as trustworthy and technical, never as a consumer hardware brand and never as glossy marketing.
brand_identity.typography: A single clear grotesque for headings and part numbers, a plain, generously set text face for the long spec tables. Nothing decorative. Numbers must be legible at a glance and unmistakable one from another.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, factual, no adjectives we cannot stand behind. We state the number, the finish and the price and we stop. If something is wrong we say so before it prints.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: We have no working brand files and no written guidelines. Our data sheets exist only as a flat press PDF the printer sent us last spring, and nobody here knows how it was built. Keep that sheet exactly as our customers recognise it. The palette and type notes above are our best account of the look, reconstructed for you, not a formal system.
brand_identity.values: Accuracy over polish. Availability. Honesty about what we stock and what a part will do. We would rather lose a sale than print a spec we cannot certify.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export and the separately listed editable source.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
